_comment: Filed altitude -> which standard FB level should be used. Ties and out-of-range values must resolve identically in both implementations.

cases.why: off-level: 1000 below FL340 boundary, nearer FL300
exact midpoint - both must break the tie the same way
above the low-level product: clamp to the highest available
below the lowest level: clamp to the lowest available
unset altitude falls back to FL300
nonsense altitude falls back rather than computing a negative nearest
